title: Yeah You Know I Do 😎
letter:
Hey, what's going on, everyone? It's me, Dominic, Elder Bundy! And I wanted to let you know how these emails are going to be going in the future!

So, I am just going to record my voice and then beneath the actual contents of the email is just going to be a transcription. I'm doing this because I feel like I always just kind of read emails and it's just, you know, it's not quite as spiced up as I would like it. So I feel like this was a good way to do that! 😁 😁

Additionally, whenever you click on the voice memo, you'll actually be taken to my website, http://missionarycompanion.com, and it will show a silly AI image of something and they'll change every single month. Just like a bunch of fun ideas and art pieces that I wanted to make on there. And so I put them up. 😎

But yeah, now about me and what's been going on. So I have my companion, his name is Elder D’Orlando. And he's an awesome guy. Super smart, great at memorizing things. Just great companion. So happy with it overall!

For what it's like at the MTC, or home MTC that is, it's actually pretty awesome because it's a great way to settle into everything. However, it definitely gets super dull being on this computer all day, and I used to, you know, I used to cold call people all the time, and this is getting to me. It's very boring 🥱 . But it is super exciting to get ready for my mission, and the work is so hard. It's so hard, but so worth it. 💪 Practicing Spanish, really learning all this doctrine and everything to help people convert to the gospel. It's just such a fulfilling thing. And so, you know, I've loved learning all these wonderful things. So I'm so excited to go out there. 😃

And so for a little spiritual thought, I wanted to share the missionary purpose, which is invite others to come unto Christ by helping them receive the restored gospel through faith in Jesus Christ and his atonement, repentance, baptism, receiving the gift of the Holy Ghost, and enduring to the end. ✝️

And while, yes, that does apply to a missionary, I think that applies to really anyone in the church. Like, I think, really, when the church says anyone can be a missionary, that they mean it and that it's very true. And I 100% support that. We can invite others to come unto Christ. And, you know, not just because of all the blessings that come with it. But simply because the relationship is just so fulfilling to know the truth of the world, to know that you have a heavenly Father who loves you, and that that alone, that acknowledgment is almost enough to live life on alone.

So, that's my thought. I hope you guys have a good time. I will send a few emails, a few extra, before I head out, and then I will probably be doing these once a month, or if you ever have a spiritual question or something unanswered, I love to answer things like that!!! So, I wouldn't be against emailing every week if that's what was going on. (Please ask!)

All right, and I hope you have a good rest of your week!!

Elder Bundy
